title: A Gm6AG-binding protein from Vibrio cholerae
authors: Yue Cao; Jialu Xu; Xueling Lu; Fengtao Huang; Weihua Chen; Xionglue Wang; Bin Zhu
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定并表征了霍乱弧菌中一种识别G6mAG基序的6mA依赖性DNA结合蛋白VchI，通过wH结构域同源建模与关键残基比较揭示其识别机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白-DNA互作且结构建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Most known modification-dependent restriction endonucleases target 5-methylcytosine, only a few N6-methyladenine (6mA)-dependent restriction endonucleases have been well-characterized, and the majority of them recognize the G6mATC motif (e.g., DpnI, HHPV4I). Here, we report the identification of a novel 6mA-dependent DNA-binding protein from Vibrio cholerae , VchI, which specifically recognizes the G6mAG motif. VchI contains a winged helix (wH) domain that is homologous to the wH domain in DpnI. However, several key residues involved in 6mA recognition differ between VchI and DpnI, which may contribute to the discrepancy in their recognition specificities. These findings advance our understanding of prokaryotic 6mA modification diversity and the 6mA recognition mechanism of the wH domain, while simultaneously providing an innovative tool for epigenetic research.
abstract_zh: 大多数已知的修饰依赖性限制性内切酶靶向5-甲基胞嘧啶，仅有少数N6-甲基腺嘌呤（6mA）依赖性限制性内切酶已被充分表征，且其中大多数识别G6mATC基序（如DpnI、HHPV4I）。在此，我们报告了一种来自霍乱弧菌的新型6mA依赖性DNA结合蛋白VchI的鉴定，该蛋白特异性识别G6mAG基序。VchI含有一个与DpnI中的翼状螺旋（wH）结构域同源的wH结构域。然而，VchI与DpnI在参与6mA识别的几个关键残基上存在差异，这可能导致了它们识别特异性的不同。这些发现增进了我们对原核生物6mA修饰多样性及wH结构域6mA识别机制的理解，同时为表观遗传学研究提供了一种创新工具。
